name: Ahogay
source:
A game in which you play as Naegi and find yourself being wooed by five guys who all want to take you to a dance.

Your choices are: Leon, Komaeda, Togami, Hinata, and Ishimaru. There are seven endings in total.

[Edited from [url=http://alteregobot.tumblr.com/post/50429810179/leonnaegi-ahogay-here-it-is-everyone-a-game]Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
一款以苗木诚为主角的游戏：五名男孩都想带你去舞会，并向你展开追求。

你可以选择狛枝、十神、日向、石丸或莱昂。总共有七个结局。

[根据 [url=http://alteregobot.tumblr.com/post/50429810179/leonnaegi-ahogay-here-it-is-everyone-a-game]Tumblr[/url]内容编辑]
